reviews.t: ... my 11& 12 year old grand daughters and they love them. They brush their hair now without Nana ...
reviews.x: I ordered these for my 11& 12 year old grand daughters and they love them. They brush their hair now without Nana and don’t complain.  Works great getting the tangles out of their curls without pulling their hair out, they both have long curly hair.
Horrible horrible horrible! Terrible product. Does not work at tangled hair, made both my kids cry tonight. Do not recommend and would never buy again. Hard bristles and not easy to hold

reviews.t: Great brushes. Detangle well without pulling on
reviews.x: Great brushes.  Detangle well without pulling on hair

These brushes work well for brushing thick and thin hair.  My daughter has very thick and long hair and I have thin hair.  They do take out tangles. They feel gentle on your hair.  I like that the bristles are soft and give your scalp a nice massage while brushing.  However, the bristles are a little short; I would have liked them to be a little longer.  The ergonomic handle is nice, except it is a little short.  I hold the brush in the center instead of the handle, and it works just fine.  I al

I grabbed up this little set for our girls.  They are 9 and 11 and have that thin, wispy prepubescent hair that easily tangles.  They refuse to let anyone help them brush their hair, even though they are terrible at actually brushing through the tangles.  I thought these might be a good tool for them to use.  They help untangle their hair without all of the pulling that comes with harder bristled brushes. They are smaller brushes, so the girls are able to handle them easier.  I really liked that

reviews.t: Best for short haired pets, not people!
reviews.x: Ok; I've been using this for about a month now and I'm a little disappointed. The shape is excellent for a right hander. Not that comfortable using if you are left handed (shaped oddly). I don't recommend using it while your hair is wet as it will just create more knots and frustrate you. The bristles are too weak to accomplish anything with wet hair (and this is on a 2 year old's thin hair). My hair is extremely long and thin-medium and it doesn't detangle well on my dry hair.  Honestly if the

I like these just because they are comfortable to comb with right down to my scalp, the bristles have enough give that it actually feels good on my scalp, unlike combs and most brushes.  But I have relatively short, easy to comb hair. When I told my daughter-in-law it was a detangling brush, she tried to demonstrate how no brush just goes through her long, wavy hair, but this one did on the first pass! She got really excited when that happened, so I gave her the pink one.

reviews.t: Not really detangling - they still hurt
reviews.x: These aren't really better than a regular brush.  I like how they fit in my hand and if you brush really, really slowly through the hair it does detangle without hurting as much.  My daughter has super fine, thin hair and it's always tangling up.  Like I said, if we brush super slow they work but I don't have time in the mornings while getting her ready. I normally just grab a comb and it does pretty much the same job.

reviews.t: Brushes don't work for me but my brother likes them.
reviews.x: I cannot use the brush at all. I have very fine frizzy hair that is fairly thick with natural waviness. I cannot even run the brush through my hair without pulling so I gave the brush to my brother and he is satisfied.  The brushes work for him.  He has thinning grey hair and the brushes are perfect for his needs.  My hair texture is unique so I don't anticipate other people having my problem.

reviews.t: These are amazing for my little girl's hair
reviews.x: These are amazing for my little girl's hair.  I am definitely not a person who's into doing hair.  Daddy does braids or any fancy hair stuff in our house.  Her hair gets so tangled and I'm always afraid to comb it hard enough to actually untangle it.  Well, these brushes actually untangle her hair and there are no tears.  As all brushes, they do make hair more frizzy.

These detangler brushes work great! I love that this a 2-pack for this price. My two daughters and I have hair that tangles easily. These work nicely for wet or dry hair. They are also the perfect size to keep in your purse, car or use for travel. We are always losing and searching for brushes in our household. I would definitely recommend these brushes!

reviews.t: Brushes with the plastic tips on the bristles seem to be too painful for her
reviews.x: Not sure there is any magical brush that will painlessly detachment hair, but this works well enough. It's gentle enough that my 5 year old daughter doesn't mind, but also delta goes the hair.  She's tried soft bristle brushes, but these don't remove the deep tangles. Brushes with the plastic tips on the bristles seem to be too painful for her.

reviews.t: Definitely try if you have curly hair
reviews.x: My daughter has curly hair and brushing her hair is always a struggle. She ends up in tears from all the tangles. This brush really does help ease the pain of getting the tangles out. We love it. It isn't a miracle worker, those tangles at the base of her scalp are still boogers but overall it makes combing her hair a much better experience.

My daughter (3 year old) hates having her hair brushed and this has helped with the process. Not really sure what the difference is between this and other other brush i use on her but something with the bristles works. We have used this for a week and it has been tear free. I would highly recommend these for toddlers.

This brush is amazing.  I have a long curly beard which gets knots all the time and this brush glides right through it, wet or dry, no problem.  My only complain is the handle is an odd size and shape and I end up gripping it like a horse brush most of the time.  Which, given my hair, is probably warranted.

I ordered even though I didn't believe it was going to work. But it did. I have tried different sprays and brushes and nothing worked like this.  At first I didn't think it was doing anything because it wasn't pulling or painful. But when I was done I ran my fingers through and the knots were gone.

reviews.t: Truly helps brush out the tangles with out the fight.
reviews.x: My daughters are 4 and 8. This is a nice product to help with the tangles that they hate for me to brush out. Only real problem is my 8 year old has much thicker hair then younger kids tend to have and the bristles aren't really long enough to effectively get all the way through her hair.

reviews.t: So I don't think its good for everyone
reviews.x: its ok for girls with short hair. My grand daughters' hair long and it doesn't get the tangles out,  bristles too soft to go through their thick long hair. Really have to work on the tangles for a long time so, they prefer using the regular brush. So I don't think its good for everyone!

reviews.t: It's good for my thin hair!!
reviews.x: My hair is a little bit thin. This brush is nice size with a great handle, it literally fits in the palm of your hand for easy use. The bristles are just right and massages the scalp with each brush stroke. I brushed right through the tangled hair. I'm so satisfied with them.

reviews.t: One for me, one for my cat!
reviews.x: Very nice brush, comfortable grip.  I used one for myself, one for my Persian cat.  While this isn't the perfect brush for a cat, the bristles were just stiff enough that it works great for a daily brushing but if there are mats I need to get out the steel comb.

I have long, thick hair that will get very tangled. I will admit i had my doubts that it would work. Very glad to say that I was wrong. It works great. Just a few strokes and my hair feels softer and tangles are gone with far less pulling and yanking needed.

several of my grand children have very thick and some very curly hair. This brush makes it so much easier to get through their hair. Very good product.  Disclaimer: I received a discount for my opinion. also ordered second set without discount.

This brush is really great, I guess Kate Middleton uses a similar one. It does take a little longer to brush my hair (I have mid-back-length hair) than a normal brush but I've noticed that less hair is pulled out when using this brush.

I have very thick hair and these just do not go through. They would be good for someone that does not have thick hair. I gave one to my old man and he likes it. He does have more normal thickness and it is long.

Got these brushes for my granddaughter who has very thick curly hair, always a crying fit when I brush her hair!! Not with this brush!! It's amazing!! No more tears!!! My granddaughter and I both love it!!!!

claims.text: Many reviewers say these brushes detangle hair effectively, including for children with curly or easily tangled hair.
Several reviewers report the brushes are gentle and comfortable, with soft bristles that don't pull or hurt.
Some reviewers find the brushes ineffective or painful, saying they still pull hair or don't detangle well.
A few reviewers mention the handle shape or grip is awkward or uncomfortable to hold.
Some reviewers note the brushes work better for certain hair types, such as short, thin, or beard hair, rather than all hair.
